name: Strawberry SC Jeeter XL Infused Pre-Roll | 2g
description: Strawberry SC layers creamy vanilla with a burst of strawberry sweetness that stays true from start to finish. The inhale leans fresh and fruity while the exhale smooths into a mellow finish that lingers without being heavy. Juicy, smooth, and like walking through strawberry fields at golden hour.
